# appium_lib

**Tag**: testing

## 简介

Helper methods for writing cross-platform Android and iOS tests in Ruby using Appium. Extends appium_lib_core with convenient methods for finding elements and interacting with devices.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/appium/ruby_lib

- 问题追踪: https://github.com/appium/ruby_lib/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/appium_lib
